description: Minimum demo scenarios for Project 09, keyed by id. Cited by instructor/checks/project-09.md. These are environment fixtures, not solutions: none of them ship a trained policy.

scenarios.description: Easy map, default reward. A trained agent should reach GOAL carrying the package in close to the shortest possible number of steps.
Hard map, default reward. DANGER cells guard shortcuts through the interior walls; a well-trained agent should route around them even though a random policy frequently hits one.
Danger zones demo: medium map has one DANGER cell next to a shortcut around the wall block. Compare a random policy (frequently hits DANGER) against a trained policy (should avoid it).

Bad reward design demo: no step cost and no danger penalty. An agent trained under this preset has no incentive to move efficiently or avoid DANGER, and can reward-hack by walking straight to GOAL without ever picking up the package (goal_without_package_reward equals goal_reward here).

Improved reward design demo: same medium map as F1, but with a real step cost, a real danger penalty (with episode termination), and a penalty for reaching GOAL without the package. Contrast the resulting policy against F1 to show the reward-design experiment's effect.
